name: web-year-and-month-picker-grid-with-black-selected-month
title: 'Better Calendar Demo' month picker: a 3x4 grid of outlined tiles with month and year, a black selected month and a Year/Month toggle
whatItIs: A white page with a bold title, a 'Year 1913' label with a two-part toggle (Year, Month active black) and a 3x4 grid of hairline-bordered tiles each showing a month name and the year in grey, with August selected as a black tile.
whatItMeans: Simple and precise; the black tile makes selection unmistakable.
techniques: Use tiles with month over year.
Add a segmented toggle for view.

vocabulary.definition: A two-option switch for view type.
The chosen option shown as solid black.
A tile with a thin light border.
